items.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Stock Climbs As Q3 Earnings Fuel Growth Case
items.summary: AbbVie entered this Q3 2026 report with a reputation as a high multiple, high expectation pharma giant. The stock had already climbed roughly 21% over the past three months and then rose another 3.1% to about US$294.83 after the release. That price move reflects one headline fact: the company reported strong third quarter numbers, with net revenue of US$17.4b and basic earnings per share of US$2.38, and it also raised full year adjusted earnings guidance.
